The record-defined intended couple is explicit; the link to the later father is inferred, without a residence below parish level or a named parent.
limitations: Janet is a possible maternal lead for James Glasgow-3523, not his assigned mother: banns alone neither prove a completed marriage nor establish the mother of a later child. Samuel’s own parents remain unknown. The existing James-to-John Glasgow-3094 working father proposal remains possible at 41%; the new banns do not bridge the seventy-year identity gap. All birth/death fields, mothers and existing father grades are preserved. No new paternal component is joined and no certainty upgrade is counted.
search_scope: A bounded anonymous WikiTree search on 18 October 2026 used FirstName Janet, LastName Broun and BirthDate 1685, returning 93 fuzzy matches on one page; this was not an exhaustive worldwide search. The nine Open, non-living exact-Janet Brown/Burn results were inspected with their biographies and spouse context. A local historical catalogue check for Janet/Jonet/Jennet/Jean/Jane Brown/Broun found no established match. Missing fields are not exclusions.
